segments.text: 39th Sutra, I think.
Eta-chir-trepada-denoprananam antar mukhat-avashtambat-dashayam-e-va-asad-e-nursant-shayat.
Yogi should not be satisfied to infuse the awareness of God-consciousness in these three states.
Turi, there is already.
But also, chitta-sthitivat-shiri karna-bhai-shu, chitta-sthitivat,
when one's mind is established in one-pointedness, chitta-sthiti.
Thiti means one-pointedness.
When one's mind is one-pointed, not only in that state,
but also, Yogi should infuse and conduct the awareness of God-consciousness
in the establishment of his body, in the establishment of his organic actions,
and outward objective world also.
In objective world, also, he should find this state of Turya.
Trepada-denoprananam-e-teva.
Trepada-a-de-anoprananam.
That man, which is the life giver of three states that Turya,
you must infuse that state in each and every action of the universe.
Yatha-antarmukhru-payaam-chitta-sthitav.
When one is introverted, and his mind is established in one-pointedness,
and that is the state of Turya.
Like that, shiri karna-bhai-abhasa-atmikayaam-bhai-ramukhata-yama-pi.
When he is extroverted, when he is not introverted, his consciousness is towards objective world.
It means that in the action of body, in the action of organs,
and in the action of external objective world.
In that too, also, antarivamarsya-avash-tambabala-ath,
he should hold the awareness of internal consciousness,
and by and by, anoprananam-kurya, he should infuse life of Turya in that state also.
It is said in Vigyana-bhai-rava.
Sarvam-jagat-sadeh-hama-sa-ananda-baritam-sumrat.
Yagupat-sa-amrat-e-naiva-parananda-mayo-bhai-at.
You should memorize your consciousness in such a way that this whole universe
or your body becomes filled with your state of bliss.
Memorize me.
Memorize. It is my own invention.
Yes.
Simrat.
Tripad-aayi-anoprananam.
It is not in Jagrat-supanand-sosyapthi there.
The meaning of that sutra is Tripad-aayi-anopranam.
You must infuse consciousness on the beginning of all these three states.
Next sutra explains you that not only in the beginning but in the center also of these states.
You must infuse consciousness of God there.
Yes. Memorize.
Memorize is correct.
Nice. Good.
Memorize.
Yagupat-sa-amrat-e-naiva.
Simultaneously with your own blissful state and then you will become one with that blissful state.
There will be no difference between that blissful state and you.
Memorize.
Yagupat-sa-amrat-e-naiva-parananda-mayo-bhai-at.
This way,
it is filled with that supreme bliss.
In each and every state of life bestows you whatever you desire.
Gathestin Nirvana-Kaara-Dimavati.
